title: FragmentLeash
description: Tie players with real vanilla ropes, fence tying, and interactive escape mechanics.
body:
**FragmentLeash** completely reworks player leashes in Minecraft.

🔗 Real vanilla-style ropes between players, with tension animation and smooth movement.

👥 Multiple players can be leashed at once, forming chains.

⛓ Tie players to fences like in vanilla Minecraft - you need a lead and must use **Shift + Right-Click** to attach.

🚫 Leashed players cannot teleport, keeping gameplay fair and predictable.

🧠 Optimized to run smoothly even on servers with hundreds of players.

🥚 Hidden Easter eggs and secret effects for players who explore carefully.

Perfect for roleplay servers, PvP scenarios, or just adding interesting new mechanics for tying and rescuing players.
